    FROM customers c

question: Which customers have bought a product from the Electronics category?
generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'Electronics';

question: How many orders were placed in the last quarter of 2025?
generated_sql:
WITH normalized_orders AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        date(REPLACE(order_date, '/', '-')) AS order_dt
    FROM orders
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM normalized_orders
WHERE order_dt BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31';
